Math Toys

f(x)Math Toys

Animated walkthroughs of Algebra I and Algebra II problems. Each tool works a problem one step at a time, the way it’s written on the board, and most let you type in your own problem to see it worked out.

Before you click to the next step, try it yourself. Turn on Quiz mode and a blank box comes up first, so you can answer before the tool shows you.

More tools

Inside a tool: → next step · ← back a step · Space play or pause.

In curriculum order, by quarter. Pick a tool to open it.
